defs.def: a set of surroundings; the place at which sth happens 环境；背景

ex.s: By creating settings in the corn fields.
ex.t: 通过在玉米地里营造场景。

ex.s: As the summer months roll in, our Georgian country estate makes the perfect setting for an outdoor fitness session.
ex.t: 来吧，在我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈的带领下，在米德尔顿庄园的场地上锻炼。

ex.s: People need permission to be funny in social settings because there’s always a risk that comes with humor.
ex.t: 在社交场合，人们需要被允许才能表现风趣，因为幽默总伴随着风险。

ex.s: Motivation and goal setting are the two sides of same coin.
ex.t: 动力和目标是同一枚硬币的两面。

ex.s: Another way of setting realistic goals is to analyze your short and long term objectives, keeping in mind your beliefs, values and strengths.
ex.t: 设定现实目标的另一种方法是分析你的短期和长期目标，同时牢记你的信念、价值观和长处。

ex.s: And consider setting a second alarm.
ex.t: 还要考虑设第二个闹钟。

ex.s: Don’t the setting make you want to visit the place?
ex.t: 难道这些布景不让你想去参观那个地方吗？

ex.s: Setting up a new standard.
ex.t: 建立一个新的标准。

ex.s: To bring your story to life, describe the settings and characters.
ex.t: 要让你的故事生动起来，请描写场景和人物。

ex.s: Settings: time, location and descriptions of the environment or surroundings help your readers picture the scene.
ex.t: 设置：时间、地点以及对环境或周围环境的描述有助于你的读者在脑海中构想出场景。

ex.s: I joined a pre-presentation dinner with him and that smaller setting allowed me to slowly build up my courage to speak one-on-one with him—an idea that had seemed completely impossible.
ex.t: 我和他一起参加了一个讲座前的晚餐，那种较小的环境让我慢慢积蓄勇气与他一对一交谈——这曾经看似完全不可能。

defs.def: the place and time at which the action of a play, novel, etc. takes place （戏剧、小说等的）情节背景

ex.s: It has a plot, settings, characters and actions, as well as dialogue between characters.
ex.t: 它有情节、场景、人物和动作，以及人物之间的对话。

ex.s: I also enjoy the creative plot and settings.
ex.t: 我也喜欢富有创意的情节和场景。

ex.s: Make sure that you plan for these difficulties at the time of setting your goals.
ex.t: 确保你在设定目标时就为这些困难做好计划。

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想有时间和家人一起吃早餐，前一天晚上就把衣服、鞋子和包准备好来节省时间。

defs.def: a position at which the controls on a machine can be set, to set the speed, height, temperature, etc. （机器上调节速度、高度、温度等的）挡，级，点

ex.s: You must keep these points in mind while setting your goals.
ex.t: 设定目标时你必须记住这些要点。

ex.s: Then you can print out a fresh draft, again setting your text on triple-space.
ex.t: 然后你可以打印一份新草稿，再次将文本设为三倍行距。

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 它还带有语音控制设置，让你无需动手，而其防水的表带可完全调节，佩戴舒适。

defs.def: music written to go with a poem, etc. （为诗等谱的）曲
a piece of metal in which a precious stone is fixed to form a piece of jewellery （镶嵌宝石的）底座，底板，托板

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

defs.def: a complete set of equipment for eating with (knife, fork, spoon, glass, etc.) for one person, arranged on a table （摆在桌上供一人用的）一套餐具

ex.s: No, this is for setting my hair yesterday.''
ex.t: “不，这是昨天做头发用的。”
